longDescription:
gImageReader is a simple optical character recognition (OCR) application which acts as a frontend to the tesseract OCR engine. Features include:

  • Import PDF documents and images from disk, scanning devices, clipboard and screenshots
  • Process multiple images and documents in one go
  • Define, manually or automatically, the recognition area
  • Recognize and export as plain text or as hOCR documents
  • Recognize text next to images
  • Post-processing recognized text, including spell checking
  • Generate PDF/ODT documents from hOCR documents
